blinding: Human review cases are populated from the pre-LLM routing input rather than from the LLM output artifact.
Row-level LLM routing decision, component, confidence, note, and response identifier are withheld from the human review table.
This is not a fully independent blinded validation because the reviewer has prior knowledge of the project and aggregate LLM results.

human_decision_contract.human_component_id: Required only for ASSIGN_COMPONENT; must be a component_id belonging to the same predecessor project work.
human_decision_contract.human_note: Concise evidence basis; required for REGISTRY_ISSUE and recommended for other decisions.

selection_policy: Include every frozen LLM row with LOW or MEDIUM confidence.
Include every ASSIGN_COMPONENT row routed to a human-defined DETACH or EXCLUDE_APPARATUS component.
For project works with a PRIMARY_SUCCESSOR_HINT component, add one deterministically selected remaining HIGH-confidence assignment when available.
For each predecessor project work, add one deterministically selected remaining HIGH-confidence assignment when available.
For each predecessor project work, add one deterministically selected remaining HIGH-confidence HOLD_UNRESOLVED row when available.
semantics: The packet combines targeted operational review with a small deterministic validation sample.
The selected rows must not be treated as a simple random sample of all 508 Editions.
Human review does not mutate the frozen raw LLM routing artifact.
REGISTRY_ISSUE allows the reviewer to flag a problem with the fixed component ontology rather than forcing an invalid assignment.
